## Summary

What changes and why. Link the issue: `Closes #123` or `Refs #123`.

## Validation

Tests and checks run, with their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, or the issue explains why none is needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or private data are added.
- [ ] Opened as a draft; marked ready for review only when complete, so CI runs on the final state.
